an5.94:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an5.94:1.4: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an5.94:1.5: āsavānañca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
